Thanks again for confirming the week of Oct 18 for the on-site + hybrid workshop. We built a draft run-of-show that splits the two workshop days into regionally staggered blocks so our US, EMEA, and APAC participants each get a live block that overlaps with at least one other region for handovers. The intent is to keep sessions concise while preserving a shared, synchronous demo window for leadership.

High-level proposal (attachment: zenith_room_layout_v3.pdf):
- Day 1: Technical deep-dive + breakouts
  - EMEA lead block: 09:00–12:30 BST (local) — overlap with late APAC for handover
  - APAC lead block: 14:00–17:30 SGT — overlap with early EMEA for shadowing
  - US evening sync: 17:00–19:00 PDT — leadership demo + Q&A (short)
- Day 2: Product roadmap + exec alignment
  - US morning: 09:00–12:30 PDT — hands-on with infra examples
  - EMEA afternoon: 16:00–19:00 BST — executive summary + next steps

Operational notes and asks:
1) Travel windows: recommend arrival windows of 24–36 hours before each region's lead block to allow AV rehearsals. Please confirm on-site arrival ETAs for your execs.
2) Local breakouts: we need two adjacent rooms and one small huddle space per region for parallel breakouts (see room map).
3) Shadowing roster: we'll provide a 6-person Redwood concierge/shadow team in three regional shifts — need your lead for each region to share a single point of contact.
4) Remote fallback: will run a redundant Zoom + regional low-latency stream (we'll test on Oct 15).

I've attached the current room layout and an initial travel manifest template (travel_manifest_zenith.csv) — please update ETAs and any dietary/access needs. If this structure works, Marcus will draft a detailed slot-by-slot timeline and a short mutual action plan.
